name: Abyssal Bathys-Corps
identity: Deep-sea pressure-suit divers, harpoon crews and leviathans. Slow, tough, and they pull the enemy to them: winch harpoons drag targets 3″, and a public Tide schedule tells both players when the Corps will strike.

rules.name: Winch-Harpoons & the Rising Tide
rules.description: Weapons with [HARPOON] that hit a Class 1–4 unit drag it 3″ straight toward the shooter (stop 1″ away; not out of engagement). The Tide is public: Round 1 Low Tide — units more than 15″ from the shooter cannot be targeted (the Hidden cap); Round 2 Flood — +2″ MOV and ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]; Round 3 High Tide — [STRIKE FIRST]; Round 4 Ebb — units may Fall Back and still Shoot or Charge.

rules.name: Gamble — Anchor-Lock
rules.description: When a unit with [HARPOON] activates: it cannot Move for the rest of the round, but its [HARPOON] weapons get +1 PEN and drag 6″ instead of 3″. (Risk: position.)

detachments.name: Deep Trench
detachments.playstyle: Advance under the fog and spring at High Tide.

rules.name: Benthic Fog
rules.description: The Low Tide 15″ targeting cap also applies in Round 2.

enhancements.name: Pressure-Lantern
enhancements.description: **Tide-Caller Oracle** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Abyssal Patience
enhancements.description: **Trench-Lord Commodore** only. The attached unit has WARD 5+.

stratagems.name: Dive!
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit targets a friendly Class 1–2 unit
stratagems.effect: That unit counts as [STEALTH] for the attack.

stratagems.name: Rise from the Deep
stratagems.effect: One unit makes a free 3″ move before the first activation.

stratagems.name: Silent Running
stratagems.effect: It is [UNSEEN 12″] until the End of Round if it does not Shoot.

detachments.name: Leviathan Pod
detachments.playstyle: Beasts and walkers anchor the line, divers fill the gaps.

rules.name: Pod-Bond
rules.description: Class 3–5 units within 6″ of each other get UNYIELDING 6+.

enhancements.name: Harpoon-Master's Claim
enhancements.description: **Abyssal Harpoon-Master** only. +1 Damage in melee on a round it charged.

stratagems.name: Feeding Frenzy
stratagems.turn: A beast destroys an enemy unit

stratagems.name: Crushing Deep
stratagems.turn: A Class 3–5 unit fights a dragged unit

stratagems.name: Ink Cloud
stratagems.effect: Attacks against it suffer −1 to Hit until the End of Round.

detachments.name: Salvage Corps
detachments.playstyle: Heavy suits and crawlers that take objectives and refuse to leave.

rules.name: Hull-Plating
rules.description: Class 1–2 units reduce incoming PEN by 1 while within 3″ of an objective.

enhancements.name: Salvage Rights
enhancements.description: **Trench-Lord Commodore** only. Objectives this model controls stay controlled ([SECURED]).

enhancements.name: Rivet-Master
enhancements.description: **Hydraulic Harpooners** only. +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Weld the Breach
stratagems.turn: A unit within 3″ of an objective activates

stratagems.name: Claim the Wreck
stratagems.turn: An enemy Class 4–5 unit is destroyed within 6″
stratagems.effect: Place an objective marker where it died (counts for Tactical cards only).

stratagems.name: Pressure Lock
stratagems.turn: A unit is charged on an objective
stratagems.effect: It cannot be moved by enemy abilities until the End of Round.
